title: With Everything I Have: Ben Frederick
content:
Silca‘s latest With Everything I Have video features our buddy and professional cyclist Ben Frederick, the dude behind The Small Monsters Project.

At 38, cyclocross racer Ben Frederick is determined to make his final season his strongest yet. His goal: earn a spot on the U.S. team for the UCI Cyclocross World Championships, held at the end of January in Ostend, Belgium. “Ben Frederick | With Everything I Have” follows Ben at Major Taylor CX weekend in Indianapolis as he races against athletes nearly half his age.

A traumatic brain injury changed the course of his career. Now, with retirement approaching, he’s committing everything to a goal he knows he might not reach. Ben speaks candidly about the difficulty of leaving competition behind, his drive to keep improving, and how he measures success when the result isn’t entirely in his control. This is Episode 8 and the season finale of “Within the Margin of Error,” a documentary series produced by County 23 Films following SILCA-sponsored athletes and the work behind their racing.

Each episode follows the fight to improve and compete, with an honest look at the setbacks, sacrifices, and personal challenges that come with it.
